rows.note: Use 溶 as the all-purpose everyday verb for something melting into liquid or disappearing into a liquid.

example.english: The sugar will dissolve as soon as it goes into hot water.
example.jyutping: di1 tong4 fong3 lok6 jit6 seoi2 zau6 jung4 saai3

rows.note: Use 解散 when an organized group, association, or institution is actively disbanded.

example.english: The school announced that it would dissolve the student union.
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 syun1 bou3 gaai2 saan3 hok6 saang1 wui2

rows.note: Use 撤銷 for formally revoking or annulling an order, decision, or legal measure.

example.english: The court decided to dissolve the restraining order against him.
example.traditional: 法庭決定撤銷對佢嘅禁制令。
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 kyut3 ding6 cit3 siu1 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 gam3 zai3 ling6

rows.note: Use 驅散 when people are driven apart or a crowd is dispersed, especially by an authority.

example.english: The police used water cannons to dissolve the crowd.
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 jung6 seoi2 paau3 keoi1 saan3 jan4 kwan4
